description: MISO wind and solar generation for today — hourly forecast vs actual output in MW for both, from the same feed MISO publishes to its operators. Hours that have not happened yet carry a forecast and a null actual (never a fake 0). Use for "how accurate was the MISO wind forecast today", "MISO solar output this afternoon", renewable-curtailment and forecast-error questions.
name: miso_wind_solar
